operator_notes: READY rows have a scalar predictor bundle on disk AND all three required sidecars on disk; the v5 fitter + closure + baseline runs can consume them directly. REGENERATE_SIDECARS_LOCAL invokes regenerate_sidecars_for_cell.py on the in-place dynamic_trace.pb. REBUILD_BUNDLE_LOCAL invokes the task5 cascade for cells with sidecars but no bundle. REBUILD_BINARY_LOCAL / REBUILD_TRACE_LOCAL are for cells that fail upstream of sidecar regeneration. CROSS_HOST_SCP / CROSS_HOST_SCP_SIDECARS fetch artifacts from another host when local regeneration is not possible. BUNDLE_TYPED_UNAVAILABLE rows have a typed-unavailable bundle on disk (e.g. cache_model_underconfigured) — these cells cannot be admitted by regenerating sidecars; the producer's underlying input is the bottleneck. BUNDLE_NON_SCALAR captures any other non-scalar result_kind. TERMINAL_TYPED_FAILURE rows are cells that cannot be admitted within the current producer surface: either excluded at the LABEL layer (relabel sweep stddev failure or provenance-duplicate eviction) OR walker-terminal (the predictor bundle's typed_reason is on the terminal allowlist, e.g. cache_model_underconfigured, where regenerating sidecars or re-running the cascade will not promote the bundle to scalar). Each terminal row carries its root cause in action_typed_reason. Root causes for {BUNDLE_TYPED_UNAVAILABLE, BUNDLE_NON_SCALAR, TERMINAL_TYPED_FAILURE} live in the separate `action_typed_reason` field (the legacy single-field colon-form is now schema-rejected). The summary `legacy_bundle_quarantined` count is the TOTAL number of stale-MPI legacy bundles on disk across admitted cells (sum of per-row `legacy_bundle_quarantined_count` values); a cell with 38 stale bundles contributes 38 to the summary, not 1. Per CLAUDE.md, sm_86 cells captured on a 3090 Ti host's sweeps survive raw scp but NOT git fetch; this manifest lets a future operator session see exactly which cells need which staging step.
